title: CtaContent
description: Call to action content: an optional badge, the heading, a description, up to two actions. One object is valid in every call to action layout (centred, at the start, the actions at the end; muted or outlined).

badge.description: a short pill above the heading; empty: no badge

description.description: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

actionLabel.description: the label of the action; the link is drawn when the label and the address are both set

secondaryActionLabel.description: the label of the second action; the link is drawn when the label and the address are both set

secondaryActionHref.description: the address of the second action
